caption: The drawing depicts a dark-colored glass bottle with a rectangular body and rounded shoulders that lead to a short cylindrical neck and a slightly wider, flat-topped rim. The bottle is positioned upright and centrally on a plain beige background. The bottle’s surface is a deep, almost blackish-green, with highlights suggesting a glossy or reflective texture. Decorative designs are visible on the front and one of the side panels of the bottle. These designs feature ornate, symmetrical motifs resembling vases with floral or leafy arrangements sprouting upwards and outwards. On the central panel, a large vase sits at the bottom, from which an elaborate arrangement of leaves or vines extends, curling and branching towards the upper part of the bottle. On the visible side panel, a similar but smaller vase and branching design is present. There is a small, faint horizontal scale marked near the bottom left corner of the drawing, separated from the main bottle image. The overall composition is centered, with the bottle sharply contrasted against the light, uncluttered background.
title: Bottle
